name: Maria Julia Margarita Josefa Emirena Justiniana LERENA Lenguas (m. HERRERA)
source: Rosario baptism, Libro 15 folio 229, act 1541, bapt. 17 Feb 1866; Montevideo marriage, San Francisco de Asis, act 1879, 3 Nov 1886
note: *** The only LERENA baptised at Rosario between 1731 and 1901 - and now followed to the end of the story. *** Born 8 October 1865, baptised at Rosario 17 February 1866 to Don Luis Lerena Lenguas and Dona Julia Juanico, "naturales del E. Oriental". On 3 November 1886, aged 21, she married Don Jaime Herrera at San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, MONTEVIDEO - the act naming her parents again, in a second country, twenty years later. She went home. *** NOT the Maria Lerena who was Pablo Armando's mother: that woman had a son in February 1882, when this one was sixteen and four years from marrying someone else. ***

name: Armando LERENA
source: Uruguay, Passenger Lists 1888-1980; index ark 1:1:QPWH-BN11, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS73-G9MX-6
note: *** THE ONLY OTHER ARMANDO LERENA FOUND ANYWHERE IN THE RIVER PLATE. *** Entry 28 on a Buenos Aires - Montevideo crossing, January/February 1910: aged 26, married, and the clerk wrote his nationality in the manifest itself as "Oriental" - Uruguayan. Read from the image, not the index. NOT Pablo Armando on the evidence: wrong nationality, two years out on the age, and in 1910 Pablo Armando was at the Cape and did not marry until September 1911. But an Armando Lerena of almost exactly his age, Uruguayan, is the shape a brother or a cousin would have.
